violations.text: Molluscan Shellfish tags are not maintained for 90 days. Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order AND the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026
